biotools.summary: eKPI is a database that integrates and ranks potential kinase-phosphosite (KPS) pairs based on multi-omics data from cancer research projects. It leverages quantitative correlations between kinase expression/phosphorylation and phosphosite phosphorylation to predict potential kinase-specific phosphorylation sites.
